QuestInfo.name: [Moon Bunny] The Bunny Chef
QuestInfo.0: Talk to the Ancient Master Baker Bunny on how their famous rice cakes came to be.
QuestInfo.1:
Do a favor for the Ancient Master Baker Bunny and report back to the Scholarly 'Shroom.

Burning Stones are in Golem's Temple: Golem's Temple 3,
and Surgeon Eye Tails are in North Forest: Young Tree Forest.


#bWhile the quest is in progress, click on [Moon Bunny] Send Me To The Moon! in the event notifier to go to the Moon, and [Moon Bunny] Ancient Baker's Request to go to Golem's Temple 3 or Young Tree Forest.#k
QuestInfo.2: You completed the Ancient Master Baker Bunny's and heard the whole story.
